# Independent statement-gate decision

Decision: changes requested; the complete statement gate is not accepted. This is a bounded mathematical statement/access decision, not proof acceptance, phase acceptance, or a review of any later commit.

Reviewed source: private local workspace commit fc62cb8cd481691b773d92dd2ef47a6eca6434c3, publication 018eadf8-81ed-4318-9858-2872dfd85013. Objective fd3670b6-cd6e-4b79-8ad8-7a0e34a016ec revision 1 was read from roadmap c040da49e1af1954f49bb954c267dc1f7043f211, docs/objective.md, blob d25e1e58256842ba422143a0912960c9d1e86479. The full maintenance mission revision 1 was read. The submitted branch remains fc62cb8; workspace main remains f5122d67c8a6692f57036ee2c40b1d29fe499f1c. Later recovery publication 83daab6 is not reviewed here.

The maintainer is independent of the statement author. Native Astra/high specialist /root/statement_fidelity performed a bounded read-only mathematical review and was collected, including its access-resolution addendum. Project reviewer descriptors are empty; listed policies are advisory with no required checks. There is no Forge item or assigned PR review generation, so settle_review is not applicable. No formal PR approval is represented by this report.

## Evidence and trust boundary

Read Geometry.lean, Statement.lean, InterfaceChecks.lean, definition-comparison.md, effort-estimate.md, statement-receipt.json, cluster-access.json, and the entire authoritative manuscript. Exact files were obtained by repository-file API after unauthenticated shell Git failed; no credential workaround was used. All eight source SHA-256 entries in the statement receipt match the exact submitted files. Manuscript SHA-256 is 8e5ae225e12eb1adcc4f3851e5e5e026e0de2b9436ba0e6e1301e8771ca90576. Local dependency HEADs match FsFltz 1a3d387cfacc746e25aad31e5b27b1803103e7cb and Mathlib d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612; Lean pin is 4.34.1.

The existing source-matched managed build and 15 transitive axiom checks were reused, not rerun. They report only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Direct reading found no sorry, admit, custom axioms or opaque proof declarations in the three project Lean files. Axiom checks on definitions of Props do not prove those Props. All four manuscript targets, plus the separate complete specialization, remain unproved.

## Mathematical assessment

- MainTarget and CommonReferenceTarget: no demonstrated scope mismatch. Dimension and native boundaryless manifold are universally quantified; radial hypotheses are restricted to R > rstar; weak taming is nonstrict at every tangent vector; each comparison form has its own existential B, C and compact exception. No metric/primitive completeness or primitive-growth hypothesis is added.
- AdmissibleGrowth uses actual ContDiffOn on the closed half-line and positive divergence of finite interval integrals as the upper limit tends to infinity. The endpoint is included. Smoothness and positivity make the integrand locally integrable on that half-line. Values below the endpoint are unused. Stein uses endpoint exp 1, correctly distinct from 1.
- Geometry.lean uses native smooth tangent Hom sections and ContMDiffRiemannianMetric. Its equality fixes g(v,w)=d beta(v,Jw). The separate fiber norm has the proved square-root formula. Covectors retain their values, with continuity obtained by finite dimension. The inverse contraction is constructed, not assumed, and its equation has the positive sign eta(inv(l),w)=l(w). Its norm is from g-dual to g.
- ExactComparison uses actual native smooth diffeomorphisms, a joint smooth family and inverse family on [0,1], a globally smooth h and both actual pullback identities. The +dh sign is correct. The extra two-form identity in corollaries is a redundant consequence, not a substantive strengthening. No Moser evolution is a hypothesis.
- CompletePrimitive and CompleteLiouvilleFlow were read at the pin. They use the actual primitive-determined field, positive contraction, Flow over all real times, joint smooth action and chart ODE for every real time. The separate complete specialization retains these witnesses for both primitives.
- FiniteTypeTarget uses t=log r, exp(t) alpha on the native end, the correct cylinder formula (v,s) maps to (Jxi v+s Reeb,-alpha(v)), and one sufficiently-large t threshold uniform in y. Compatibility of the ambient J forces the contact compatibility implicit in this presentation. The new primitive is correctly not assumed complete.
- ProperComplexEmbedding has an actual proper smooth topological embedding, immersion and CR differential equation. These are mathematically appropriate for the complex-submanifold presentation. The Stein primitive equation determines the intended beta and its compatible metric, but supplying those bundles is not the same as constructing them from the source embedding; see R1.

## Required repairs

R1 — Stein source-level construction coverage (blocking). Statement.lean:117-144 defines the embedding relative to an already supplied ExactSymplecticStructure S and CompatibleStructure A. The manuscript begins with a proper holomorphic embedding and constructs beta, Omega and the induced metric. Current SteinTarget is a valid packaged conditional target, but alone does not cover that construction. Add a source-level embedding entrypoint independent of assumed symplectic reference/metric, and expose the construction/coverage obligation that furnishes those determined data, including g equal to the pullback Euclidean metric. Prove representation bridges used to identify it with the packaged target, or retain the separate unproved construction target explicitly in the full acceptance contract. Do not silently discharge this missing construction by requiring symplecticity or compatibility as additional source hypotheses. A complete Moser comparison proof is not requested at this gate.

R2 — Incorporate newly available reuse evidence (blocking for the current crosswalk, not an access failure). The submitted cluster-access.json and crosswalk record a real historical authentication failure. Operator notice c59fa2ae-7c99-4165-9a70-314ab1366f17 supplied the exact cluster snapshot during this review. Access is now resolved. Update the source-bound crosswalk/access record and effort estimate with the inspected declarations below, their scope and remaining hypotheses. Preserve the historical failed read as history; do not continue reporting that source is unavailable. Before developing new infrastructure, follow Mathlib -> FsFltz -> cluster -> new work and prove any adaptation bridges.

C1 — Nonblocking finite-type crosswalk clarification. Native Completion requires a boundaryless extension embedding and end identities for all real logarithmic times. No additional geometric restriction was demonstrated: the actual completed X can be the extension itself, with W as carrier and identity inclusion; the complete Liouville flow propagates the boundary immersion and exp(t) alpha identity backward. Record this same-manifold explanation and any needed native presentation bridge; the upstream interface name alone is not evidence of reverse coverage. Constructing the radial exhaustion is later proof work, not an additional hypothesis.

## Resolved access and concrete reuse assessment

Read-only source: /mnt/c/Users/Mingyuan Hu/.codex/.chatgpt-projects/g-p-6ad684ad65d0819199a22617723f57a7/archon_liouville/cluster-source-2c239b0/Hu-Mingyuan-cluster-skeleton-2c239b0c03922a1549f18ee3a45a8e0ca25bb28c. Read AGENTS.md, GeometryTarget.lean, NativeCompleteFlow.lean, NativeCompleteFlowInterface.md, the associated consumer, and dependency pins. Archive SHA-256 was independently recomputed as afcc79188f8c340faaf5c1abca49e7d4a82358a2a7e8395dbe013a9693089eb6; these six inspected files match archive members byte-for-byte. The operator provenance receipt identifies commit 2c239b0c03922a1549f18ee3a45a8e0ca25bb28c. No changes were made to this source.

GeometryTarget.LiouvilleData uses the pinned FsFltz CompleteLiouvilleFlow literally. Its toCompleteLiouvilleManifold preserves manifold, primitive, field and flow; field_eq_liouvilleVector identifies the unique positive-contraction field. It is specialized to a cluster SmoothPresentation, so the generic current CompletePrimitive interface is the appropriate lower-level reuse. It is not necessary to import a cluster carrier into the general comparison statement.

NativeCompleteFlow.exists_global_integralCurve proves all-real solutions for the particular GlobalLiouvilleField.Z using finite-horizon confinement and uniform compact local lifetimes. exists_completeLiouvilleFlow derives the group law by uniqueness and invokes pinned smooth dependence; exists_global_integralCurve_through and exists_extension_Ioo cover shifted initial times and both omitted endpoints. These are useful proof patterns, not ready-made theorems for arbitrary time-dependent Moser fields. Their cluster seed, parameter and confinement hypotheses must not enter MainTarget.

The cluster proof points directly to existing generic FsFltz declarations, now checked at the actual pin: CollarFlow.contMDiff_joint_of_isMIntegralCurve (CollarSmoothEvolution.lean:513) gives joint time/initial-point regularity from smooth autonomous field and actual all-real solutions; contMDiff_joint_of_hasMFDerivAt (:552) gives joint initial-time/final-time/initial-point regularity for a smooth time-dependent field from actual all-real solution data. CollarEvolution.exists_compact_uniform_local_integralCurve and FlowBridge.isMIntegralCurve_iff_chart_solves are further reuse candidates. They do not construct the comparison flows from the manuscript hypotheses. Global existence/compactness, interval extension or reparametrization needed to meet their all-real assumptions, and exactness remain to prove. The early estimate should distinguish this discovered smooth-dependence infrastructure from the remaining globalization problem; no new numerical schedule is warranted by this bounded inspection.

All statement repair, documentation incorporation, renewed exact-source checks and integration remain with assignment 05f12d87-cb78-4af9-97d3-acef5ae50334 / mission 35518290-ed35-47a8-a227-c5d55b1c117f. Its open ledger item is 8eaa8fff-4cea-4422-a71e-8739f73082f8. It is retained pending this maintainer assignment's terminal completed/failed/cancelled result. The maintenance decision is complete once this report and handoff are recorded; the statement gate and full objective remain open.
